title: goldeneye telemetry event envelope v1
description: Every event in the goldeneye data lake is one JSON object per line (JSONL) matching this envelope. Schema evolution is by version bump (envelope.v2.json), never in-place edits. Payloads MUST NOT contain secrets or credentials.

event_id.description: Unique id; v1 uses <epoch-nanos>-<pid>-<rand>. Wave 3 (Rust ingest Lambda) upgrades to ULID.

spec_id.description: Unit-of-Work directory name (e.g. '002-datalake-v1') when the event belongs to a spec

actor.description: Who emitted it: human | claude-main | intent-assurance | spec-auditor | property-auditor | hook

event_type.description: Dotted family.name. Families: spec.* (lifecycle: doc_written, status_changed), assurance.* (verdict), gate.* (notified, approved, revised), task.* (started, done, deviation), test.* (pbt_run, counterexample, triage), build.* (build, deploy, coldstart, memory), session.* (start, stop), learning.* (concept_mastered, question)
